texts.facts: The petitioner has filed this petition under Section 166 of Motor Vehicle Act, claiming compensation of Rs.30,00,000/- for the accidental injuries sustained by him in a road traffic accident took place on 22.05.2023. 2. Hence, the respondents are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation to the petitioner. Hence, the petitioner has filed this petition for a compensation of Rs.30,00,000/- with interest.
texts.arguments: The learned counsel for petitioner quoted decision of Hon'ble High court of Karnataka, Bangalore in MFA NO.1419/2023 between H. P. Nagegowda and Subramanya Kalluraya, wherein Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka held that, 'tribunal has to accept the evidence of neuro-surgoen when the mental faculties of a person is involved'.
